subject.title: [Feature]: Agents page selector should be a themed HTML dropdown showing agent avatars

question: Should the Agents page adopt this compact custom avatar dropdown, defer to the broader visible-list/sidebar direction, or keep the native select for now?
rationale: Current main confirms the requested behavior is missing, but the issue has a protected maintainer label and the permanent Agents navigation pattern is a visible Control UI product/design choice.

options.title: Adopt compact avatar dropdown
options.body: Implement the requested accessible themed dropdown as an incremental toolbar improvement while leaving the visible-list/sidebar request tracked separately.

options.title: Fold into visible-list work
options.body: Close or supersede this narrow dropdown idea only after maintainers decide that the broader visible-list/sidebar direction is the intended Agents page navigation.

options.title: Keep native select
options.body: Document that the native select is intentional for now and avoid investing in a custom selector until a larger Agents page redesign is chosen.

recommendation.title: Adopt compact avatar dropdown
recommendation.body: Implement the requested accessible themed dropdown as an incremental toolbar improvement while leaving the visible-list/sidebar request tracked separately.

likelyOwner.reason: He opened the protected-label issue and has the strongest product/design routing signal plus relevant Control UI history.
